food-kulhi-boakibaa.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: travel food discovery card, landscape 3:2. Create one elegant editorial watercolor and gouache illustration, distinctly hand-painted rather than a photograph. Accurate, appetizing finished food fills about 75 percent of the frame. Three-quarter overhead composition, lightly textured warm ivory paper and restrained soft wash background, natural daylight, rich food color, fine brushwork and clear silhouettes that remain readable as a small card. No text, lettering, watermark, logo, collage, split panels or extra unrelated dishes. Subject: Maldivian kulhi boakibaa savory baked fish cake: several modest square slices on a simple small ceramic plate. Thin golden-brown baked tops, dense pale yellow crumb visibly flecked with shredded cooked tuna, grated coconut, fine onion and tiny green curry-leaf and chili flecks. One slice tilted to reveal the compact rice-based interior. The savory cakes are flat tray-baked squares, not sweet sponge cake, no icing, no raw fish garnish, no breadcrumb-coated fish patties.
